verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no sandbox or test environment that isolates testing from production data. The approval mode where "nothing changes on disk" is a dry-run style gate, not sandbox isolation. Per-task git worktrees, in-browser Python execution and air-gapped deployment are adjacent features that do not provide a separate test environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
